metadata.label: earned-union-v1-training-shard5

rules.ownership: Maximum item/upgrade levels and per-ID furniture count; union regions/cats/decor/signatures. Every nonstarter asset is purchased again; no imported cash/pantry/runtime.
rules.equipment: Highest comfort owned item in each slot; lexicographically smallest id on ties.
rules.placement: Keep existing starter clock/mugrack; place new furniture by sorted id, first legal main-room grid coordinate in row-major order. Fail if none; no results-based layout changes.
rules.progress: Shared per-item maximum factual experience, maximum day/served/handoffs; neutral empty reviews; synthetic fixture, not a single earned save.
rules.reserve: Funding = ceil(exact independent quoted purchase cash / .88); all remainder retained; 12% minimum starting working cash.

metadata.methodology: Paid common capability union of six pre-existing earned late snapshots, not a single earned save. Five original menus crossed with six focuses plus plain. Identical assets, funding, progress and clock. All stock/care/campaign expenses and pending service retained. Original v1 evidence preserved.
